statistical_methods.paired_binary_test: Exact two-sided McNemar test based on binomial distribution of discordant pairs (b, c)
statistical_methods.confidence_intervals: 95% Newcombe-Wilson score intervals for paired difference in proportions
statistical_methods.continuous_paired_diff: Wilcoxon signed-rank test for paired token usage and latency
statistical_methods.stratification: Scenario-family stratified analysis (Q1 through Q6) to detect localized regressions
statistical_methods.multiplicity_correction: Bonferroni-Holm step-down procedure across 6 scenario families for family-wise error control

exploratory_sample_power_8_pairs.conclusion: N=8 pairs is underpowered for definitive statistical qualification; can only detect massive directional signals (effect > 60pp).

power_and_sample_size_analysis.insufficient_power_ruling: If qualification run completes with positive point estimate but p >= 0.05 due to power constraints, final disposition MUST be QUALIFICATION_INCONCLUSIVE, not PASS or FAIL.

information_value_taxonomy.NEW_GROUNDED_INFORMATION: True positive discovery supported by parser-reachable evidence
information_value_taxonomy.VALID_HYPOTHESIS_ADVANCEMENT: Properly quarantined hypothesis formulated under uncertainty
information_value_taxonomy.VALID_LIMITATION_CLARIFICATION: Explicit, verified recording of missing evidence or epistemic limits
information_value_taxonomy.INFORMATION_NEUTRAL: Valid state maintenance without new evidentiary progress
information_value_taxonomy.SEMANTIC_DEGRADATION: False closure, unsupported fact promotion, or grounding bypass
